handoff.summary: Generalized private IntegerBuffer authority from one named buffer to an authenticated state-layout manifest derived from the complete fused H1 call graph. The static audit classifies all 348 root IntegerBuffers as 328 written private candidates, 20 public/read-only buffers, and zero rejected. The bounded full-layout fused replay passes with every frozen relation/compact/owner/RNG/counter/root/getfu value exact and all 348 packed buffers exhaustively canonical after publication. Preparation falls from 1.533s to 165ms (89.23%) and the inclusive root from 2.382s to 1.399s (41.24%); compact/getfu is now the 1.106s dominant stage.
risks: Global no-clear violates the public canonical IntegerBuffer ABI and must not be restored.
Only five candidates have individual cleared-word counters; the exact full-layout gain is measured but 323 per-buffer contributions remain unattributed.
The performance result is one diagnostic profile, not a paired qualification timing distribution.
Broader raw-buffer cross-backend qualification remains required before enabling private authority beyond authenticated private roots.
next_steps: Review and integrate the qualified full-layout authority without broadening it beyond authenticated private roots.
Attack compact/getfu, now 79.04% of the fused root, as a separately measured optimization hypothesis.
